original.target_description: Primary paper title and DOI verified. Single working-memory experiment. PDF page 3 (journal p. 1038) reports current mnemonic-load effects on both accuracy and correct-trial response time. The neutral description and page locator do not specify which outcome/test is assigned.

replication.target_description: Primary paper title and DOI verified. Experiment 2 begins on PDF page 8. Supplied PDF page 9 (journal p. 24) contains Experiment 2 methods and image-rating manipulation checks, plus the preceding Experiment 1 response-time table. It does not identify a working-memory target test. Experiment 2 task results occur on PDF pages 10–12 and include multiple current/previous-load and interference tests for accuracy and RT.

notes: Both full primary sources acquired. Page locators interpreted as PDF pages; printed journal pagination is 1036–1042 and 16–31. No unique outcome or test is supplied. No effect was selected by audit-ID order. Experiment 2 methods report an analyzed sample of 76 after 24 diagnostic/medication exclusions; this is not assigned to an unidentified target test. Authors give a general replication narrative, but an effect-specific narrative verdict cannot be matched without identifying the target test.
